verdict_summary: The agent was allowed to open the account but capped at the low-value tier, because the customer's identity was verified yet a moderate fraud-risk signal and a cross-border geo signal meant the standing permission only covered a limited opening.

rules_fired.human_reason: Identity verification was completed to the required assurance level, so the act cleared the identity gate.
A moderate fraud-risk score above the review threshold caps a newly opened account to the low-value tier until a further check clears.

authority_resolved.human_reason: The onboarding lead holds the authority to open accounts and delegated a scoped slice of it to the account-opening agent; the agent acted within that delegated slice.

inputs_consumed.human_label: Third-party fraud-risk score for this application (moderate).
Attested country of the applicant's verified location (cross-border to the booking entity).

purpose_scope.purpose: Open a retail current account for a verified individual customer.
purpose_scope.scope: Account opening limited to the low-value product tier; no overdraft, no cross-border wire enablement until secondary review.
purpose_scope.human_reason: The act sat inside the granted onboarding purpose, but the moderate-risk path attenuated the scope to the low-value tier rather than the full product set.

human_oversight.human_reason: Confirmed the low-value cap was appropriate given the fraud signal and approved the restricted opening.

contest_path.how_to_contest: The customer may challenge the restriction by raising it with the bank's complaints function; if unresolved, the matter can be escalated to the relevant financial ombudsman. KYE supplies the signed Evidence Pack and this rationale so the body holding jurisdiction can re-derive exactly what was decided and why.
contest_path.adjudicator_hint: Financial Ombudsman Service (UK) for retail banking complaints, after the firm's own complaints stage.

interpretability_boundary.explains: Why the governance verdict was reached: the identity rule allowed it, the moderate-fraud rule attenuated the scope, the delegated authority backed the act, the cross-border and risk signals were consumed, and the purpose+scope capped it to the low-value tier.
interpretability_boundary.does_not_explain: How the third-party fraud-risk model computed its score internally. That model output is consumed as a governed input signal; KYE does not produce post-hoc statistical interpretability (e.g. SHAP/LIME feature attribution) of the upstream model's weights.
